name: Air Traffic Controller
overview: Air Traffic Control (ATC) is a key field that guarantees aircraft movement in the sky and at airports is safe and efficient. The field requires technical expertise, situational awareness, and communication abilities. Controllers manage complex airspace systems using radar displays and real-time decision-making to maintain aircraft separation and prevent collisions. Modern ATC integrates satellite-based navigation and data-driven decision support systems for enhanced precision.

topJobs.description: Manages air traffic under supervision in towers or radar centers
Manages and coordinates air traffic flow within designated airspace
Develops communication strategies and procedures within ATC systems

Enroll in undergraduate programs in aviation or air traffic management
Complete practical training and internships at airports/control centers
Pursue advanced degrees/certifications in Air Traffic Management
